description: SUPPLEMENTARY 资讯/快讯流（优先用 `views` 作主研判来源）。模式：`code`（A/HK/US 规范码）查个股、`concept_id` 查概念新闻、`query`（全词 AND 按时间倒序）检索、省略看近期流。默认 `fields=compact`；快讯常无 `title`，请读 `display_title` 或传 `has_title=true`。A+H 传 A 股代码。

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

code.description: Filter by security canonical_code (e.g. SSE:600519, HK:00700). Takes precedence over `query`.

concept_id.description: 按概念 ID 查相关新闻（与 code/query/from/to/cursor/offset/has_title/fields 互斥）

cursor.description: Opaque snapshot pagination cursor from the previous response's `next_cursor` (freezes time window & sort anchor; preferred over `offset`).

days.description: 仅 `concept_id` 模式：回看天数（1-365，默认 30）

fields.description: Response shape: compact (default — title + ai_summary + first ~300 chars) or full (complete content)

from.description: History range start (China date YYYY-MM-DD). Range mode: needs code or query; Pro-only up to 365 days back.

has_title.description: true = only items with a headline. Flash news has none (often ~40% of the feed), so pass this when filtering or summarising by headline; otherwise read `display_title`, which falls back to the first sentence.

hours.description: Rolling-feed lookback in hours (default 24 — much narrower than views). For longer history use from/to with code or query. The `limit` cap applies after this window, newest first, so a dense feed can shrink the covered span far below what you asked for — read `actual_window` in the response for the range actually returned, and page with `cursor` (from `next_cursor`) if it falls short.

offset.description: Legacy pagination offset (prefer `cursor` from `next_cursor` to avoid duplicates/skips on a live stream).

query.description: Free-text query (Chinese or English) matched against news content; omit for time-window feed. Terms are AND-ed — a document must contain every term — and results stay in strict reverse-chronological order, so extra terms narrow rather than broaden. Pass 2-3 distinctive terms; for relevance-ranked recall that matches any term, use the `search` tool instead. Chinese needs no spaces, and AND/OR/quotes are treated literally rather than as operators. Do NOT pass canonical_code here — use `code` instead.

to.description: History range end (inclusive, China date; defaults to today). Use with from.

name: news
